name: Annas
summary: A high priest and the father-in-law of Caiaphas. Jesus was brought to him first after His arrest, and later he sat with the council that questioned Peter and John.

key_moments.title: Has Jesus Brought to Him First
key_moments.description: After Jesus was arrested and bound, the officers led Him first to Annas, the father-in-law of Caiaphas. There Jesus was questioned about His disciples and His teaching, and an officer struck Him.

key_moments.title: Sends Jesus Bound to Caiaphas
key_moments.description: Annas sent Jesus, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.

key_moments.title: Questions Peter and John
key_moments.description: Annas the high priest gathered at Jerusalem with Caiaphas and the high priest's family, and they asked Peter and John by what power or name they had healed a man. They threatened them, commanded them not to teach in Jesus' name, and let them go.
